title: Juice N Power Caramel Milkshake 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: A deliciously rich and creamy milkshake eliquid with top notes of comforting caramel and a background hint of sweet, dark toffee. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks.
